scripts.test:e2e: tmp="$(mktemp -t takt-e2e.XXXXXX)"; npm run test:e2e:mock >"$tmp" 2>&1; code=$?; cat "$tmp"; if grep -q "error connecting to api.github.com" "$tmp"; then echo "[takt] GitHub connectivity error detected in E2E output"; code=1; fi; rm -f "$tmp"; if [ "$code" -eq 0 ]; then msg='test:e2e passed'; else msg="test:e2e failed (exit=$code)"; fi; if command -v osascript >/dev/null 2>&1; then osascript -e "display notification \"$msg\" with title \"takt\" subtitle \"E2E\"" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; echo "[takt] $msg"; exit $code
scripts.test:e2e:all: npm run test:e2e:mock && npm run test:e2e:provider
scripts.test:e2e:provider: npm run test:e2e:provider:claude && npm run test:e2e:provider:claude-sdk && npm run test:e2e:provider:codex && npm run test:e2e:provider:opencode
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm run build
